text.description_html:
Acorn WP8BP, 13-1/2 Inch Warwick Rough Iron Door Pull

Acorn's WP8BP Warwick Iron Door Pull lends itself to the outdoor lifestyle, from out on the ranch back 40 years ago to a more urban barn style decor. However, it is great for use on screen doors and closet doors as well. Where ever you choose to use this iron handle, it insures you will have a firm grip no matter the style of your decor. It's easy to install with just a few screws. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles, cathedrals, and colonial architecture by imitating the natural weathering of iron.

Also Available: 10-3/4" Warwick Door Pull

Specifications of the 13-1/2" Warwick Rough Iron Door Pull:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Length: 13-1/2"
  • Width: 3-1/4"
  • Projection: 3"
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.
